Subject: Intro + hands-on walkthrough request (DataWeave listing)

Hi Logan,

We came across Redwood Inference on the CloudMarket listing this morning and it looks like a promising fit for a POC we’re planning. I’m the platform lead for DataWeave and would love a short product walkthrough and a hands-on demo focused on latency, model variants, and deployment options (VPC).

High-level goals:
- Validate inferencing latency at 1k QPS with mixed sequence lengths
- Understand private deployment/KMS integration for PII handling
- Quick pricing sketch for a 3-month POC

Are you available for a 30–45 minute demo next week? We’re currently targeting: Wed Apr 14 at 10:00 AM PT or Thu Apr 15 at 11:00 AM PT. I’ve attached a short RFP outline.

Attachments: DataWeave_RFP.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 page stub)

Thanks,
Tom Harris
